profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer @ TEKVOX | Student-Athlete | BS Computer Science | MS Computer Science @ St. Mary’s University
profile.summary:
Graduate with a Master’s degree in Computer Science from St. Mary’s University with experience designing and building full-stack and backend software solutions using C#, .NET, Python, cloud infrastructure, and data-driven applications. I enjoy turning complex datasets into useful products and building systems that are scalable, maintainable, and practical.

Highlighted Experience & Projects

KTA – Baseball Analytics Platform
Designed and developed a full-stack application using .NET, Blazor, and MAUI to analyze TrackMan baseball data for collegiate programs. Built interactive dashboards and advanced analytics including BAA, OPS, OBP, SLG, pitch analysis, heat maps, launch angle visualization, and release metrics inspired by professional baseball analytics platforms.

Tek Vox Inc.
Developed and maintained scalable WPF and AWS-based applications, improved backend architecture through service refactoring, and implemented monitoring solutions to increase reliability and observability in production environments.

Vox Base
Built full-stack software using .NET Core, ASP.NET, and WPF to track device state history and streamline internal product and operational workflows.

I’m interested in opportunities across software engineering, backend development, cloud systems, and data-focused applications, with an emphasis on building products that solve real-world problems.

projects.title: KTA
projects.description:
KTA is a baseball analytics platform that leverages TrackMan data to deliver in-depth performance analysis for collegiate baseball teams. Built on the .NET framework, the application features a Blazor/MAUI front end with a C# backend, providing a modern, responsive user experience.

The platform offers advanced statistical metrics—including BAA, OPS, OBP, and SLG—alongside Baseball Savant–style visualizations such as launch angle analysis, heat maps, and release height charts. Users can upload TrackMan .csv files directly into the system, which are then transformed into cleanly formatted tables and interactive dashboards.

With powerful visual tools and advanced metrics readily accessible, KTA enables coaches and analysts to gain a comprehensive understanding of both pitcher and hitter performance.

projects.title: SlackR
projects.description:
SlackR is a stat-tracking tool designed for the Valorant community, blending serious analytics with a comedic edge. It tracks both traditional stats like kills, assists, and first deaths, and quirky metrics like whiff percentage, baits, and Rounds Clutched Against (RCA). By analyzing gameplay data, SlackR assigns users a rank and player archetype, offering a unique perspective on player performance.

SlackR pulls data using a combination of direct API calls (via Python's requests library) and Selenium for web scraping, ensuring accurate and up-to-date stats. This data is processed into easy-to-read reports and visualizations that offer players a mix of insight and humor, making competitive analysis both engaging and fun.
